description: Ghana - Off-grid Solar Installations Capacity & Quantity is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Extractive industries", published or maintained by World Bank Group. This dataset also consists of data on other non-grid connected solar installations/applications such as standalone solar solutions, lanterns, solar pumps, and solar water heaters. The capacities of the solar pumps and the water heaters in terms of their flow rates and volumes respectively are reported. This dataset was last updated in June 2014. Coverage: Ghana. It has 1 file in CSV. The portal files it under Extractive industries. The portal gives 2018 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
